_provenance: Supplementary Appendix F: Gaming Resistance Pathways and Assessment.

data.description: A developer restricts the validation cohort to subpopulations where the system performs well.
The choice of gold-standard outcome definition materially affects performance metrics.
The governance threshold is selected after reviewing validation results rather than being pre-specified.
For Primary Safety Thresholds, the party conducting the gaming resistance assessment should have no commercial interest in the outcome.
